What Your Job Will Be Like

 
We are seeking high level project lead and technical contributor to support the program development of access delay (specifically the Mobile Vault). The successful candidate is required to have a strong technical background and have a proven record of leading and contributing to technical teams. They will work with both experienced and junior staff members and technologists and will ultimately be responsible for the successful design, testing, evaluation, management, and deployment of the Mobile Vault and other physical protection technologies. They will also be responsible for helping develop new customers, both externally facing and within the laboratory with a strong focus on customer and program development. 

On a given day the successful candidate will be:

  • Briefing high level stakeholders, partnering with end-users to develop Concepts of Operations (CONOPS), interfacing with commercial partners, providing direction to technical teams, developing customers, and serve as the mechanical systems lead for the Mobile Vault.  
  • Leading a fast paced, cross disciplinary team developing new capabilities for the DoW and DOE to support the physical security of assets and materials.
  • Leading and contributing to key national security challenges with real world impact and near-term fielding and deployment. 

Due to the nature of this work the selected applicant will need to work onsite and be able to travel occasionally.
